premises.text: Video consumption is surging while creators get savvier, increasing demand for video output
premises.evidence_span: video consumption is going through the roof, but also people are getting savvier to create their own video

premises.text: Studio-controlled production and wild uncurated UGC are separate worlds that must be bridged
premises.evidence_span: The video landscape is divided on one side we have a tightly controlled industry driven by studios and agencies and on the other side there's this explosion of user generated content online that's kind of crazy and wild and uncurated

premises.text: Companies can produce high-impact video at scale by engaging their own fans, customers, and employees as filmers
premises.evidence_span: produce high-impact video at scale by engaging their own communities of fans, customers, and employees to become the filmers

premises.text: Product is client tools to engage their own communities, not a third-party filmer marketplace
premises.evidence_span: We're not building a scenic community. Instead, we're building the tools to enable our clients to engage and create with their own communities

premises.text: Clients load filming instructions and in-app terms grant reuse rights over uploaded community footage
premises.evidence_span: they loaded filming instruction that they wanted their community to capture

premises.text: Uploads are auto-tagged and processed, with editing in-platform, in external tools, or via remote freelancers
premises.evidence_span: All of the video is then automatically tagged, analyzed, and processed on upload as well. Then there's 3 ways to edit

premises.text: Monetization is a subscription studio model
premises.evidence_span: now we're fully into a subscription model

premises.text: Machine-learning search (sentiment, objects, transcription) makes the content library reusable
premises.evidence_span: search sentiment analysis object recognition and transcription
